name: TheIntroDB
description: Adds skip segments for intros, recaps, credits, and previews from TheIntroDB's API.
overview: Adds skip segments for intros, recaps, credits, and previews from TheIntroDB's API.

versions.changelog:
## What's Changed
* fix: guard CTS disposal in usage reporting service against double dispose by @Pasithea0 in https://github.com/TheIntroDB/jellyfin-plugin/pull/24

Fixes https://github.com/TheIntroDB/jellyfin-plugin/issues/23 - Jellyfin no longer exits with an unhandled System.ObjectDisposedException on shutdown/restart.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/TheIntroDB/jellyfin-plugin/compare/v1.0.7.3...v1.0.7.4

## What's Changed
* fix: rate-limit safety margin and preserve segments on transient API failures by @Pasithea0 in https://github.com/TheIntroDB/jellyfin-plugin/pull/22


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/TheIntroDB/jellyfin-plugin/compare/v1.0.7.2...v1.0.7.3

## Changes made
- Fix on demand fetching ignoring selected items filters

## Changes made
- cleaned up “on library add” code to avoid shutdown race condition

## Changes made
- Added support for .strm format video files
- Added automatic file scanning when added to library (no manual/scheduled scan task required)

## Changes made
- Added TheIntroDB menu option to sidebar
- Rounded API key test acceptance rate to two decimals

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/TheIntroDB/jellyfin-plugin/compare/v1.0.6.0...v1.0.6.1
